description: Hi! I’m Dua Destghir. I have studied human biology and have a strong interest in the human health, and biological sciences. I’m looking to form a team where I can contribute biology knowledge while learning from people with different skills. I’d like to work with teammates skilled in technology, coding, and data analysis so we can combine our strengths and create an innovative project.
summary: Astra is a two-minute daily self-check that helps astronauts spot changes in their psychological and physical wellbeing, with no ground contact needed. Astronauts answer quick questions, take three short thinking tests, and tap a body map to show where they have pain. Astra compares the results with their own baseline and suggests CBT, DBT, and physical exercises to match. Data stays private, and the OpenAI assistant help the astronaut act early.
details: Aggregates Apple Watch health metrics (readiness score, sleep duration, resting heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen) and flags multi-indicator baseline shifts (e.g., correlating 30+ minutes of exercise with longer sleep or alerting when blood oxygen drops below 95%). Combines an 8-question daily physical check-in with an interactive Body Map to log localized stiffness, weakness, or discomfort and recommend targeted assessments with live BPM monitoring and post exercise | feedback Tracks mood, sleep, stress, cognitive task scores, and high-workload days. When indicators shift from baseline, it recommends tailored self-help skills adapted from Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) such as DEAR MAN, PLEASE, and Wise Mind Pause. Includes an on-device Private Journal that is strictly isolated-never shared, analyzed, or sent to the Al. ong-duration missions expose astronauts to isolation, circadian disruption, microgravity deconditioning, and space radiation. ASTR4 bridges the gap between raw telemetry and actionable daily habits. By detecting subtle shifts across physical, cognitive, and environmental metrics before they become critical, it helps astronauts self-regulate workload and recovery while preserving psychological safety through strict data-privacy boundaries.
